name: sk-attachment-tray
title: Attachment Tray
description: Files staged for sending, each with its own progress ring on the thumbnail rather than one shared bar — three uploads at three speeds cannot be described by a single percentage. Removal animates the remaining tiles closed so it is clear which one went.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage: SKAttachmentTray(attachments: files, onRemove: remove, onAdd: pick)
